beats.vo: Two grids on one coin can both try to hold the same inventory. Last page you wrote range, spacing, and stop for one grid. A second band on the same coin does not create a second pile of inventory by magic. On the diagram for this beat, look for two bands on one column, both arrows pointing at the same stack. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Draw one coin name, then two bands, and circle the stack they both want. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. This picture is not a claim that two grids are safer than one. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Hook. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

This is Grid Bot Elite. The lesson is Multi-layer grids as inventory buckets. Teal on the frame. Not the Blueprint plate. Education only. You will write on paper before any screen.

By the end you can treat a layer as an inventory bucket. A bucket has a name, a band, and a stop. If you cannot name the bucket, the layer is only a second set of lines. On the diagram for this beat, look for two buckets, each labelled with a band, under one coin name. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Name the buckets Core and Inner on the example page. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. Naming them does not make them two piles of coins. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to A layer is a bucket. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

In this example a core band is wide and a second band sits inside it. The inner band is a drawing inside the outer band. It is marked Example. It is not a pair of settings to copy. On the diagram for this beat, look for a wide band and a narrower band inside it, stamped Example. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Draw the outer lines first, then the inner lines, and write Example at the top. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. Starting from the inner band and hoping an outer range appears is the miss. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Core and inner. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

That overlap is the risk in the picture. Where the bands share prices, both grids can try to hold the same inventory. The drawing should show one stack, not two. On the diagram for this beat, look for the shared prices hatched, with one inventory tag on the hatch. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Hatch the overlap and write one inventory line beside it. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. Two tags on one hatch pretend you hold the inventory twice. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Overlap. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

The inner band can still fall with the first coin. A second band is not a second asset. If the coin leaves, both drawings leave with it. On the diagram for this beat, look for one coin falling through both bands together. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Write the coin name once, above both bands. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. A second band is not a hedge just because it is thinner. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Same coin. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

No curve of results is drawn. A results curve would pretend the example already happened. The example is a drawing of buckets. On the diagram for this beat, look for an empty results box crossed out beside the two bands. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. If you sketched a rising curve, cross it out. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. Past or imagined results do not indicate future results. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to No results curve. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. Two tags are the miss. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Quiz. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Recap. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.
